question: Should CodexBar permanently expose this local Share Stats workflow in both the status menu and Settings?
rationale: VISION.md requires sign-off for new features and meaningful maintenance complexity, and the PR intentionally adds two permanent user-facing entry points.

options.title: Approve both entry points
options.body: Keep the menu and Settings actions after the availability defect is fixed and focused validation remains green.

options.title: Approve one entry point
options.body: Retain the export workflow but expose it only from the status menu or Settings to reduce permanent UI surface.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Close the PR if shareable usage artifacts are outside CodexBar's intended control-surface scope.

recommendation.title: Approve both entry points
recommendation.body: Keep the menu and Settings actions after the availability defect is fixed and focused validation remains green.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the clearest product-direction owner and has recently merged the adjacent multi-account menu work.
